extension.summary: Passerelle entre l'application BaCine et Kodi
extension.description: Reçoit les demandes de l'application Android TV BaCine et ouvre la recherche globale de vStream sur le film choisi. Ne s'utilise pas seul depuis Kodi.
extension.summary: Bridge between the BaCine app and Kodi
extension.description: Receives requests from the BaCine Android TV app and opens vStream's global search for the chosen film. Not meant to be opened from Kodi directly.
